title: Sergio Mendes & Brasil '66 Look Around 8-Track, A&M L-51-137
descriptionText: The product is an 8-track cartridge of the album "Look Around" by Sergio Mendes & Brasil '66. Released by A&M Records, this format offers a nostalgic listening experience that was popular in the 1960s and 1970s. Fans of Sergio Mendes and Latin music from that era would appreciate adding this vintage piece to their music collection.
